text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r e-n-g-a-g-e-d t-h-e l-o-g-i-n p-r-o-c-e-s-s u-s-i-n-g r-e-c-o-v-e-r-y m-e-t-h-o-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-e-s-s-i-o-n s-t-a-r-t a-n-d a d-e-v-i-c-e f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t i-n t-h-e a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l, w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n l-a-y-e-r.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-p-l-o-i-t-e-d g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e t-h-r-o-u-g-h m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n-s, u-s-i-n-g p-r-o-c-e-s-s-e-d p-a-y-m-e-n-t d-e-t-a-i-l-s t-o c-o-n-v-e-r-t t-o g-o-o-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-a-r-d-u-s-e h-i-s-t-o-r-y a-n-d a f-u-l-f-i-l-l-m-e-n-t r-e-c-o-r-d, b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e f-r-a-u-d-s-c-o-r-e t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d c-h-e-c-k.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d p-r-o-f-i-l-e a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-s t-o m-i-m-i-c n-o-r-m-a-l u-s-e-r b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s, r-e-q-u-i-r-i-n-g a-c-c-e-s-s t-o a-c-c-o-u-n-t s-e-t-t-i-n-g-s a-n-d c-o-o-k-i-e i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-o-o-k-i-e u-p-d-a-t-e t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p a-n-d a s-e-s-s-i-o-n m-a-t-c-h i-n-d-i-c-a-t-o-r, b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r-a-l a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s a-n-d a-n-o-m-a-l-y d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-o-u-t-e-d f-u-n-d-s t-o o-u-t-s-i-d-e r-e-c-i-p-i-e-n-t-s v-i-a t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r m-e-t-h-o-d-s, u-s-i-n-g e-n-c-r-y-p-t-e-d c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s a-n-d a-n-o-n-y-m-o-u-s s-e-r-v-i-c-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r l-o-g e-n-t-r-y a-n-d a c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a r-e-c-o-r-d, b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g a-n-d k-n-o-w-n-b-a-d-a-c-t-o-r b-l-a-c-k-l-i-s-t s-c-r-e-e-n-i-n-g.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n-e-d a-c-c-e-s-s t-o c-l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s b-y a-v-o-i-d-i-n-g i-n-c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-c-y i-n a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y, r-e-q-u-i-r-i-n-g o-n-g-o-i-n-g s-e-s-s-i-o-n m-a-n-a-g-e-m-e-n-t a-n-d a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n r-e-f-r-e-s-h, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a l-o-n-g l-i-v-i-n-g s-e-s-s-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d a-n-d a t-o-k-e-n r-e-f-r-e-s-h a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l, b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e p-e-r-i-o-d-i-c r-e-a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n a-n-d u-n-u-s-u-a-l a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y a-l-e-r-t s-y-s-t-e-m.
